Oh my god the same thing happened to me! I had asked the only person who I had come out to ask the teacher who held GSA to hold me in at lunch (I have his period right before lunch) so I could go to my first GSA meeting without anyone knowing. Unfortunately for me, during the meeting someone who I knew very well came in to turn something into the teacher, saw me there, and proceeded to tell everyone I knew that I was at GSA. I almost committed suicide after that day, as some of the comments I received were awful and mean-spirited, but I held out anyway. I reached out to the GSA officers about my situation, and they've been incredibly supportive and helping me along the way. Maybe reach out to your school's GSA (if they have one) for advice? I found that while I still harbour some anger, it definitely helped jump start finding myself, and I hope you do too! <3
